task.original_goal: Implement an Android Calm Utility prototype offline search results slice that displays a short, readable matched-text snippet for full-body search hits, with clear no-match and unavailable-index states, entirely offline and without changing search index schema or safety review status.
task.roadmap_source: docs/OFFLINE_SEARCH_BULK_ROADMAP.md S2 (relevance and search UX); DESIGN.md Calm Utility; docs/PRODUCT_BRIEF.md offline reference prototype
task.implementation_hint: Worker 1 first inspect current Android search UI, result models and available text retrieval on the approved integration base, and all open draft PRs #22-#25. Freeze an achievable vertical slice: reuse existing indexed result IDs and installed article content; show a bounded context snippet around matched query terms, with accessible fallback for title-only matches and corrupt/unavailable index. Do not copy unmerged PR code, add network requests, publish new guides or imply expert review. If equivalent UI already exists or approved base lacks required APIs, select a different independently buildable approved S2 Android slice before freezing.
implementation_paths: app/src/main/java/com/justtobesafe/app/data/OfflineKnowledgeLibrary.kt (only if needed for bounded on-demand body retrieval)
app/src/main/java/com/justtobesafe/app/data/OfflineGuideLibrary.kt (only if needed for urban body retrieval)
task.verified_baseline: GuidesScreen.kt shows knowledge entry.summary and urban title/status, not body-match snippets; OfflineFullTextIndex.search returns IDs only; OfflineKnowledgeLibrary.readArticle loads a single on-demand pack with 2-pack LRU; OfflineGuideLibrary.articleFor returns installed urban sections; existing search uses getOrNull and silently falls back to metadata when shard fails.
task.delivery: Pure deterministic bounded snippet formatter (new Kotlin helper permissible) + GuidesScreen wiring for full-body hits and honest error states; preserve metadata fallback, stable IDs, navigation, category filters and draft warnings.

acceptance_criteria: For a nonblank query whose ID appears in OfflineFullTextIndex.search but not in title/summary/tags, GuidesScreen shows a concise readable excerpt from the installed article body with matching term context, bounded to <= 180 visible characters and no more than 2 lines; do not eagerly decode all knowledge packs.
For title-only, summary-only or unavailable article-body cases show the existing metadata summary or a clear non-misleading fallback; no invented matched quote and no publication/review claim.

For a blank query show normal category-filtered catalogue without snippets; for zero results show explicit no-match state; for null, corrupt or failed full-text index show a distinct accessible title/topic-only fallback notice, never silently pretend full-text results are complete.
Keep existing stable guide ID navigation, category chips, draft safety labels and offline-only search; no network, analytics, schema/tokenizer, index assets or permissions changes.

Add deterministic Kotlin tests covering match in middle/end, case and Unicode, no term, whitespace, long paragraph truncation, missing body and failed index-result UI-state selection; demonstrate an actual installed-body match through a focused UI-state/unit integration fixture.

On exact task-branch head run focused Gradle unit tests and :app:assembleDebug in read-only standard public GitHub Actions (<=12 minutes), plus static review for accessibility, content claims and no network; record run ID, head SHA, exit codes, and physical P30 testing as unverified.
